checks.detail: missing=[]
one object owns one folder/local-actor cutpoint on one exact handle slot
sender pressure is not mislabeled as evidence validity
the API exposes both the local mint map digest and the unkeyed cutpoint caveat
durable attestation does not clone all evidence merely to hash local counter bindings
the exact receipt and its unexpired deadline jointly control every terminal transition
callers can distinguish missing, stale, expired, extended, and already-covered receipts
migration source and receipt-bearing destination schema are both exact contracts
restart cannot forget which attempt owns settlement authority
an unrelated trigger/index name cannot hide executable attachment to a replica table
the owner never silently repairs a partial or augmented protocol schema
foreign keys are enabled outside the transaction and schema SQL is not trusted
declared references are enforced and independently scanned on every cutpoint load
stored summaries never replace exact operation-byte authority
each destination stores only identity, generation, and dispatch authority
same-dot fork substitution cannot preserve the durable cutpoint unnoticed
claim replacement or backoff edits cannot preserve the structural seal
casual/torn metadata edits cannot independently relabel a generation
schema, canonical bytes, parent graph, model state, views, and either outbox version are one read cutpoint
successful TEMP-trigger row mutation cannot be returned as a committed publication
malformed rev0869 state cannot be laundered by rebuilding metadata
outbox capacity is proven before mint; commit follows full staged restore
outbox capacity is proven before mint; commit follows full staged restore
duplicate/self fanout and independent count/byte pressure are explicit errors
only newly retained evidence advances the SQLite state generation
CSPRNG latency cannot hold SQLite's writer slot while the loaded cutpoint still binds the token
receipt uniqueness is not derived solely from clocks or worker names
a trigger or competing writer cannot silently retarget the mutation
settlement, renewal, and release no longer repeat linear key scans
claim, heartbeat, and release cannot drift in generation or precommit attestation behavior
a stale, released, or expired attempt cannot retire an unsettled intent
renewal cannot revive expiry, shorten a lease, or advance generation for an already-covered deadline
retry scheduling is a fenced durable transition with an explicit maximum delay
callers cannot accidentally bypass attempt-bound settlement
restart cannot silently reinterpret retained evidence under caller defaults
tests exercise live-receipt revocation and precommit corruption boundaries, not only delivery
CMake registers both authority layers and the process-crash test budget
a sealed archive cannot omit the cutpoint owner, heartbeat audit, or structural audit
constraint conflicts abort the typed transaction instead of being normalized away
full-history reload/reprojection is correctness scaffolding, not a production scaling claim
